subject: Partner gating: prioritization request & exception path
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@cloudnexus.com>
To: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudNexus Partner Team <partners@cloudnexus.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Integration gating prerequisites and timing

Hey Jordan —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our partnerships team is trying to map Redwood into our marketplace listing pipeline. Two quick asks from our side:

1) Can you confirm the minimal gating artifacts for a marketplace listing (attestations, SSO, billing SKU entitlements)?
2) If we request a temporary listing exception (we have a co-sell pilot with a customer next month), what’s the typical time to approval and what product constraints apply?

If easier, happy to do a 30-min call this week.

Best,
Samantha
Samantha Lee
Head of Partner Ops, CloudNexus

From: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@cloudnexus.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Integration gating prerequisites and timing

Hi Samantha —

Appreciate the note. Looping in product (Marissa) and marketplace/dev relations (Karthik, Ben) so we can give a concrete checklist and an exception path. Short answers up front:

- Minimal artifacts: security questionnaire (SOC2 or equivalent summary), API spec + test sandbox, billing SKU mapping, and a basic integration guide.
- Temporary listing exceptions: we do these but require an MSA addendum + a risk review; typical turnaround 2–3 weeks if artifacts are complete, longer if we need engineering changes.

Marissa / team — can you confirm the current gating doc we point partners to and whether the CloudNexus pilot qualifies for a fast-track exception? Also attaching the initial notes from Samantha.

Jordan Blake
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@cloudnexus.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 10:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Integration gating prerequisites and timing

Thanks, Jordan. Quick product read — I pulled the current marketplace gating checklist and sketched a prioritization note for this partner. Attaching the checklist and our API spec excerpt.

A few clarifications / asks from product before we commit to a fast-track exception:

- Sandbox surface: Does CloudNexus need read-only embeddings and inference only, or will they need to exercise dedicated capacity (private/dedicated) for the pilot? If dedicated, we need a provisioning ETA.
- Security evidence: a SOC2 summary + specific data-flow diagram showing where PII is filtered is sufficient for initial review. We can accept CloudNexus-owned logs for the pilot if they confirm retention is <=30 days.
- Billing: we need expected monthly token volume and whether CloudNexus will resell (marketplace billing) or simply integrate (referral). Reselling triggers entitlement gating.

Proposed prioritization for exceptions:
- A: Customer-facing pilots with an active co-sell opportunity + NDA + estimated >$10k MRR => priority review (1–2 weeks)
- B: Technical integrations / sandbox-only pilots => standard queue (3–6 weeks)

If CloudNexus confirms pilot is A, we’ll route to the exceptions flow and request the addendum + minimal technical checklist.

Marissa Cole
Director, Product Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Attachments: gating-checklist.xlsx (see tab: "fast-track-criteria"), integration-specs-v2.pdf

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@cloudnexus.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Integration gating prerequisites and timing

Folks — adding delivery and legal ops perspective. A couple of pragmatic notes and an ask for next steps: 

- Timeline: If partner marks pilot as "A" (Marissa’s definition), legal can push an MSA addendum + risk sign-off in ~10 business days provided we get the SOC2 summary and data-flow diagram within 48 hours. Engineering provisioning for a dedicated sandbox can take 7–10 business days depending on queue.
- Entitlements: If CloudNexus wants to surface Redwood as a billed SKU in their marketplace (resale), procurement must sign a reseller schedule — that adds ~3 weeks. For a pilot where Redwood bills directly, no reseller schedule needed.
- Can Samantha drop the HubSpot opportunity ID and an initial estimate of token volume (monthly) so we can size capacity? That lets us decide whether to propose a shared sandbox or dedicated instance.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) CloudNexus: confirm pilot classification (A/B) + provide HS opportunity id (HubSpot).
2) CloudNexus: upload SOC2 summary + data-flow diagram to the Drive link (I’ll share a folder).
3) Redwood: if A, open exception ticket and assign an engineer for provisioning.

Thanks — I can own the exception ticket and timeline coordination once we have the artifacts.

Karthik Iyer
Partner Integrations Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@cloudnexus.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Integration gating prerequisites and timing

Thanks everyone — quick update from our side:

- Pilot classification: A (co-sell pilot with Acme Retail; expected billing model: Redwood direct billing for pilot).
- HubSpot opportunity: HS-4521 (link in attachments).
- Token estimate: approx 2.5M tokens/month for pilot peak.
- SOC2 summary & data-flow diagram: uploaded to the Drive link you shared (folder: CloudNexus/Redwood-Pilot).

Next asks from CloudNexus:
- Can Redwood provision a shared sandbox with read/write inference access by Aug 31? The pilot kickoff is 09/06 and we need a few days for QA.
- Please initiate the exception ticket and confirm the engineer point-of-contact.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

—
Samantha Lee
Head of Partner Ops, CloudNexus
